stem.en: A registered party is recognised neither as a national party nor as a State party. What is true of its candidates?

text.en: They can contest, with no reserved party symbol.
They must stand on a national party's symbol.
They cannot contest until the party is recognised.
They must all share one symbol across the whole of India.

explanation.en: A registered party can contest elections even if it is not recognised. Election symbols are allotted to national and state parties, so this party has no reserved symbol. Its candidates choose a free symbol from a list.

hints.en: Being registered and being recognised are two different things.
Which classes of party are allotted election symbols?
